queries.sql: SELECT `pm`.`id`, `pm`.`product_id`, `pm`.`product_title`, `pm`.`category_id`, `pm`.`price`, `pm`.`slug`, `pm`.`compare_price`, `pm`.`product_image`, `pm`.`product_status`, `pm`.`product_type`, `pm`.`seo_title`, `pm`.`seo_description`, `pm`.`short_description`, `pm`.`description`, `pm`.`price_offer_type`, `pm`.`premium_product`, `pm`.`featured_product`, `pm`.`created_at`, `pm`.`updated_at`, `c`.`category` as `category`, `ps`.`size_name`, `ps`.`width`, `ps`.`height`, `ps`.`extra_price`, `ps`.`multiplier` FROM `product_management` as `pm` LEFT JOIN `categories` as `c` ON `c`.`id` = `pm`.`category_id` LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_id, MIN(extra_price) as min_price FROM product_sizes GROUP BY product_id) as lowest_size ON `lowest_size`.`product_id` = `pm`.`id` LEFT JOIN `product_sizes` as `ps` ON `ps`.`product_id` = `pm`.`id` AND `ps`.`extra_price` = `lowest_size`.`min_price` WHERE `c`.`slug` = 'customize'
